E8.25_late.meaning: filename reference label; Data Protocol describes approximately E8.3, not exact E8.25
E8.25_late.usage: summary only; no exact-time main source pairing in this run

official_samples: WT sample identifiers are file-level units; no embryo identity inferred. Gata4 two released inputs retain author embryo IDs.
FENG_samples: name is MULTI-seq chamber sampling group; four groups are not four confirmed independent embryos.
MOSTA_samples: one file-level summary unit; slices are technical sections, not biological replicates.
QIU_samples: 12 explicit embryo IDs in selected allowed E8.75-E9.5 rows; E8.0-E8.5 author range excluded because it is not an exact E8.5 collection label.
gene_identity_correction: Sgol2 resolves through NCBI68549/MGI1098767/ENSMUSG00000026039 to historical Sgol2a; supplement_alias has one-gene projection and checks; original outputs retained.
